statement: N-0050 line-window questions for Warren (n0050/IMPL.md): (1) 292 of 309 cases with lines have non-week-aligned case windows; lines copy the case window as-is and are flagged window_week_straddle. For a future supersede: keep case start/end days, snap to Mon-Sun, or treat the case's own weekday cycle as its week? (2) out-of-window override claims when a product has two windows - last line, nearest line, or operator picks? (now reported unplaced, not counted; no cip data affected today). (3) add overlap enforcement (gist exclusion or service check) with the supersede writer? (4) historical staging rows carry their own windows - keep per-row windows for historical lines? (5) pre-existing: 2 duplicate-grain groups with NULL pod_quarter on cip.
